_comment: Remote (Streamable HTTP) server block. Enable it in StyleNotes under Settings -> MCP -> Remote access, pick an exposure tier (This device for the same machine, Local network for another machine), then copy the endpoint URL and the access token shown there into this block. Replace http://127.0.0.1:7317/mcp with the LAN address when the client is on another machine. The token is shown once; rotate it in Settings if it leaks. A client that only speaks stdio can bridge with: npx -y mcp-remote http://127.0.0.1:7317/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer <token>".
